message.reasoning:
I'm checking my cash position after mortgaging Short Line—I have $146, but red houses cost $150 each, so I'm just short. Looking at my property distribution, I have one house on Illinois but none on Kentucky or Indiana, so I'd need to build on those to maintain even development. The buildable properties list is empty though, which suggests I can't build right now, likely because I don't have enough cash to afford the minimum house cost.

I'm considering mortgaging another property to get over $150. Tennessee or St. James would give me around $110-$114, which would put me at $256-$260 total—enough to build a house on Kentucky or Indiana and still have cash left over. That would increase my income since each red house generates rent. But I'm also aware my cash position is precarious, especially with Gemini owning Pennsylvania where I might land next, so I need to weigh the risk of thinning my reserves further against the benefit of building more houses.
